svg.aria-label: The End. A credits card under a slowly drifting starfield in a gold frame, soft fireworks in the corners: big golden pixel letters read THE END, then THANKS FOR PLAYING. The cast, each with a portrait: APEHEAD as himself; Brakka Ironlever, the lever; the Clockwork Choir, coding agents; Gus, deletions; Xal'Zor, the dashboards; Vel'Krann, legacy (defeated). Then: a game by Alexander Curiel, Principal Engineer at Spotahome, with the ape paladin cheering on the left and the six relics on the right.
